items.headline: Jon Rahm's $25M Fine Settlement
items.text: Jon Rahm agreed to settle a $25 million fine to regain PGA Tour membership after clearing $4 million in outstanding fines in May 2026.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Joins DP World Tour
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau committed to playing the Nedbank Golf Challenge in South Africa this December amid LIV Golf's season-ending turmoil, signaling cross-tour participation.
